_comment: Sample for WIKI_LLM_PROVIDER=custom. Copy, edit, then set WIKI_LLM_CUSTOM_CONFIG=<path>. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Placeholders (only inside string values): {model} {system} {prompt} {temperature} {max_tokens} {stream} {response_format} {api_key} {uuid}. A value that is exactly one placeholder keeps its type. Put the key in WIKI_LLM_API_KEY or WIKI_LLM_API_KEY_FILE, never in this file.
